verses.textZhCnvs: 生气却不要犯罪；含怒不可到日落。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且穿上新人；这新人是照着神的形象造的，有真理的仁义和圣洁。
verses.textEnNiv: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.
verses.textEnEsv: and to put on the new self, created after the likeness of God in true righteousness and holiness.
verses.textEnNkjv: and that you put on the new man which was created according to God, in true righteousness and holiness.
verses.textEnNlt: Put on your new nature, created to be like God—truly righteous and holy.
verses.textEnNasb: and to put on the new self, which in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of the truth.
verses.textEn: and to put on the new self, created to be like God in true righteousness and holiness.

verses.textZh: 不可给魔鬼留地步。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可给魔鬼留地步。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话，因为我们是互相为肢体。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor, for we are all members of one body.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, having put away falsehood, let each one of you speak the truth with his neighbor, for we are members one of another.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, putting away lying, "Let each one ofyou speak truth with his neighbor," for we are members of one another.
verses.textEnNlt: So stop telling lies. Let us tell our neighbors the truth, for we are all parts of the same body.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, ridding yourselves of falsehood, speak truth each one of you with his neighbor, because we are parts of one another.
verses.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor, for we are all members of one body.

verses.textZh: 偷窃的，不要再偷，却要作工，亲手作正当的事，使自己可以把所得到的，分给缺乏的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 偷窃的，不要再偷，却要作工，亲手作正当的事，使自己可以把所得到的，分给缺乏的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 生气却不要犯罪；不可含怒到日落，
verses.textEnNiv: "In your anger do not sin" : Do not let the sun go down while you are still angry,
verses.textEnEsv: Be angry and do not sin; do not let the sun go down on your anger,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Be angry, and do not sin": do not let the sun go down on your wrath,
verses.textEnNlt: And "don’t sin by letting anger control you." Don’t let the sun go down while you are still angry,
verses.textEnNasb: Be angry, and yet do not sin; do not let the sun go down on your anger,
verses.textEn: "In your anger do not sin" : Do not let the sun go down while you are still angry,

verses.textZh: 一句坏话也不可出口，却要适当地说造就人的好话，使听见的人得益处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一句坏话也不可出口，却要适当地说造就人的好话，使听见的人得益处。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不可给魔鬼留地步。
verses.textEnNiv: and do not give the devil a foothold.
verses.textEnEsv: and give no opportunity to the devil.
verses.textEnNkjv: nor give place to the devil.
verses.textEnNlt: for anger gives a foothold to the devil.
verses.textEnNasb: and do not give the devil an opportunity.
verses.textEn: and do not give the devil a foothold.

verses.textZh: 不可让神的圣灵忧伤，因为你们受了他的印记，等候得赎的日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可让神的圣灵忧伤，因为你们受了他的印记，等候得赎的日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前偷窃的，不要再偷；总要劳力，亲手做正经事，就可有余分给那缺少的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Anyone who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing something useful with their own hands, that they may have something to share with those in need.
verses.textEnEsv: Let the thief no longer steal, but rather let him labor, doing honest work with his own hands, so that he may have something to share with anyone in need.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let him who stole steal no longer, but rather let him labor, working with his hands what is good, that he may have something to give him who has need.
verses.textEnNlt: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Instead, use your hands for good hard work, and then give generously to others in need.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who steals must no longer steal; but rather he must labor, producing with his own hands what is good, so that he will have something to share with the one who has need.
verses.textEn: Anyone who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing something useful with their own hands, that they may have something to share with those in need.

verses.textZh: 一切苛刻、恼怒、暴戾、嚷闹、毁谤，连同一切恶毒，都应当从你们中间除掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一切苛刻、恼怒、暴戾、嚷闹、毁谤，连同一切恶毒，都应当从你们中间除掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 污秽的言语一句不可出口，只要随事说造就人的好话，叫听见的人得益处。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not let any unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building others up according to their needs, that it may benefit those who listen.
verses.textEnEsv: Let no corrupting talk come out of your mouths, but only such as is good for building up, as fits the occasion, that it may give grace to those who hear.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let no corrupt word proceed out of your mouth, but what is good for necessary edification, that it may impart grace to the hearers.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t use foul or abusive language. Let everything you say be good and helpful, so that your words will be an encouragement to those who hear them.
verses.textEnNasb: Let no unwholesome word come out of your mouth, but if there is any good word for edification according to the need of the moment, say that, so that it will give grace to those who hear.
verses.textEn: Do not let any unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building others up according to their needs, that it may benefit those who listen.

verses.textZh: 要互相友爱，存温柔的心，彼此饶恕，就像神在基督里饶恕了你们一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要互相友爱，存温柔的心，彼此饶恕，就像神在基督里饶恕了你们一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要叫神的圣灵担忧；你们原是受了他的印记，等候得赎的日子来到。
verses.textEnNiv: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, with whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
verses.textEnEsv: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
verses.textEnNkjv: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
verses.textEnNlt: And do not bring sorrow to God’s Holy Spirit by the way you live. Remember, he has identified you as his own, guaranteeing that you will be saved on the day of redemption.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
verses.textEn: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, with whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

verses.textZh: 一切苦毒、恼恨、忿怒、嚷闹、毁谤，并一切的恶毒 ，都当从你们中间除掉；
verses.textZhCnvs: 一切苦毒、恼恨、忿怒、嚷闹、毁谤，并一切的恶毒 ，都当从你们中间除掉；
verses.textZhCuv: 一切苦毒、恼恨、忿怒、嚷闹、毁谤，并一切的恶毒 ，都当从你们中间除掉；
verses.textEnNiv: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, brawling and slander, along with every form of malice.
verses.textEnEsv: Let all bitterness and wrath and anger and clamor and slander be put away from you, along with all malice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, clamor, and evil speaking be put away from you, with all malice.
verses.textEnNlt: Get rid of all bitterness, rage, anger, harsh words, and slander, as well as all types of evil behavior.
verses.textEnNasb: All bitterness, wrath, anger, clamor, and slander must be removed from you, along with all malice.
verses.textEn: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, brawling and slander, along with every form of malice.

verses.textZh: 并要以恩慈相待，存怜悯的心，彼此饶恕，正如神在基督里饶恕了你们一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并要以恩慈相待，存怜悯的心，彼此饶恕，正如神在基督里饶恕了你们一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 并要以恩慈相待，存怜悯的心，彼此饶恕，正如神在基督里饶恕了你们一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.
verses.textEnEsv: Be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, as God in Christ forgave you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God in Christ forgave you.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, be kind to each other, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, just as God through Christ has forgiven you.
verses.textEnNasb: Be kind to one another, compassionate, forgiving each other, just as God in Christ also has forgiven you.
verses.textEn: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.

verses.textZh: 因此，你们既然是蒙爱的儿女，就应当效法神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你们既然是蒙爱的儿女，就应当效法神。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们该效法神，好像蒙慈爱的儿女一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Follow God’s example, therefore, as dearly loved children
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore be imitators of God, as beloved children.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore be imitators of God as dear children.
verses.textEnNlt: Imitate God, therefore, in everything you do, because you are his dear children.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore be imitators of God, as beloved children;
verses.textEn: Follow God’s example, therefore, as dearly loved children

verses.textZh: 要凭着爱心行事，好象基督爱我们，为我们舍己，当作馨香的供品和祭物献给神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要凭着爱心行事，好象基督爱我们，为我们舍己，当作馨香的供品和祭物献给神。
verses.textZhCuv: 也要凭爱心行事，正如基督爱我们，为我们舍了自己，当作馨香的供物和祭物，献与神。
verses.textEnNiv: and walk in the way of love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself up for us as a fragrant offering and sacrifice to God.
verses.textEnEsv: And walk in love, as Christ loved us and gave himself up for us, a fragrant offering and sacrifice to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: And walk in love, as Christ also has loved us and given Himself for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling aroma.
verses.textEnNlt: Live a life filled with love, following the example of Christ. He loved us and offered himself as a sacrifice for us, a pleasing aroma to God.
verses.textEnNasb: and walk in love, just as Christ also loved you and gave Himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God as a fragrant aroma.
verses.textEn: and walk in the way of love, just as Christ loved us and gave himself up for us as a fragrant offering and sacrifice to God.

verses.textZh: 至于淫乱和任何污秽或贪心的事，在你们中间连提都不可提，才合圣徒的体统。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于淫乱和任何污秽或贪心的事，在你们中间连提都不可提，才合圣徒的体统。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于淫乱并一切污秽，或是贪婪，在你们中间连提都不可，方合圣徒的体统。
verses.textEnNiv: But among you there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed, because these are improper for God’s holy people.
verses.textEnEsv: But sexual immorality and all impurity or covetousness must not even be named among you, as is proper among saints.
verses.textEnNkjv: But fornication and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be named among you, as is fitting for saints;
verses.textEnNlt: Let there be no sexual immorality, impurity, or greed among you. Such sins have no place among God’s people.
verses.textEnNasb: But sexual immorality or any impurity or greed must not even be mentioned among you, as is proper among saints;
verses.textEn: But among you there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed, because these are improper for God’s holy people.

verses.textZh: 更不要讲淫秽和愚妄的话，或下流的笑话，这些都与你们不相称；却要说感谢的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 更不要讲淫秽和愚妄的话，或下流的笑话，这些都与你们不相称；却要说感谢的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 淫词、妄语，和戏笑的话都不相宜；总要说感谢的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Nor should there be obscenity, foolish talk or coarse joking, which are out of place, but rather thanksgiving.
verses.textEnEsv: Let there be no filthiness nor foolish talk nor crude joking, which are out of place, but instead let there be thanksgiving.
verses.textEnNkjv: neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor coarse jesting, which are not fitting, but rather giving of thanks.
verses.textEnNlt: Obscene stories, foolish talk, and coarse jokes—these are not for you. Instead, let there be thankfulness to God.
verses.textEnNasb: and there must be no filthiness or foolish talk, or vulgar joking, which are not fitting, but rather giving of thanks.
verses.textEn: Nor should there be obscenity, foolish talk or coarse joking, which are out of place, but rather thanksgiving.

verses.textZh: 因为你们确实知道，无论是淫乱的、污秽的或贪心的 ，都得不到在基督和神的国里的基业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们确实知道，无论是淫乱的、污秽的或贪心的 ，都得不到在基督和神的国里的基业。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你们确实地知道，无论是淫乱的，是污秽的，是有贪心的，在基督和神的国里都是无分的。有贪心的，就与拜偶像的一样。
verses.textEnNiv: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure or greedy person—such a person is an idolater—has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
verses.textEnEsv: For you may be sure of this, that everyone who is sexually immoral or impure, or who is covetous ( that is, an idolater), has no inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this you know, that no fornicator, unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God.
verses.textEnNlt: You can be sure that no immoral, impure, or greedy person will inherit the Kingdom of Christ and of God. For a greedy person is an idolater, worshiping the things of this world.
verses.textEnNasb: For this you know with certainty, that no sexually immoral or impure or greedy person, which amounts to an idolater, has an inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God.
verses.textEn: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure or greedy person—such a person is an idolater—has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

verses.textZh: 不要给别人用空言欺骗了你们，正因为这些事，神的震怒必定临到那些悖逆的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要给别人用空言欺骗了你们，正因为这些事，神的震怒必定临到那些悖逆的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要被人虚浮的话欺哄；因这些事，神的忿怒必临到那悖逆之子。
verses.textEnNiv: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things God’s wrath comes on those who are disobedient.
verses.textEnEsv: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be fooled by those who try to excuse these sins, for the anger of God will fall on all who disobey him.
verses.textEnNasb: See that no one deceives you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience.
verses.textEn: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things God’s wrath comes on those who are disobedient.

verses.textZh: 所以，不要与他们同流合污。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，不要与他们同流合污。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们不要与他们同伙。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore do not be partners with them.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore do not become partners with them;
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore do not be partakers with them.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t participate in the things these people do.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore do not become partners with them;
verses.textEn: Therefore do not be partners with them.

verses.textZh: 你们从前是黑暗的，现今在主里却是光明的，行事为人就应当像光明的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们从前是黑暗的，现今在主里却是光明的，行事为人就应当像光明的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前你们是暗昧的，但如今在主里面是光明的，行事为人就当像光明的子女。
verses.textEnNiv: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Live as children of light
verses.textEnEsv: for at one time you were darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light
verses.textEnNkjv: For you were once darkness, but now youare light in the Lord. Walk as children of light
verses.textEnNlt: For once you were full of darkness, but now you have light from the Lord. So live as people of light!
verses.textEnNasb: for you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord; walk as children of light
verses.textEn: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Live as children of light

verses.textZh: 光明所结的果子，就是一切良善、公义、诚实。
verses.textZhCnvs: 光明所结的果子，就是一切良善、公义、诚实。
verses.textZhCuv: 光明所结的果子就是一切良善、公义、诚实。
verses.textEnNiv: (for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness and truth)
verses.textEnEsv: (for the fruit of light is found in all that is good and right and true),
verses.textEnNkjv: (for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness, righteousness, and truth),
verses.textEnNlt: For this light within you produces only what is good and right and true.
verses.textEnNasb: (for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth),
verses.textEn: (for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness and truth)

verses.textZh: 你们要察验甚么是主所喜悦的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要察验甚么是主所喜悦的。
verses.textZhCuv: 总要察验何为主所喜悦的事。
verses.textEnNiv: and find out what pleases the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: and try to discern what is pleasing to the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: finding out what is acceptable to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Carefully determine what pleases the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: as you try to learn what is pleasing to the Lord.
verses.textEn: and find out what pleases the Lord.

verses.textZh: 不要参与暗昧无益的事，倒要把它揭露出来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要参与暗昧无益的事，倒要把它揭露出来，
verses.textZhCuv: 那暗昧无益的事，不要与人同行，倒要责备行这事的人；
verses.textEnNiv: Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.
verses.textEnEsv: Take no part in the unfruitful works of darkness, but instead expose them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather expose them.
verses.textEnNlt: Take no part in the worthless deeds of evil and darkness; instead, expose them.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not participate in the useless deeds of darkness, but instead even expose them;
verses.textEn: Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.

verses.textZh: 因为他们暗中所作的事，连提起来也是羞耻的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们暗中所作的事，连提起来也是羞耻的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们暗中所行的，就是提起来也是可耻的。
verses.textEnNiv: It is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is shameful even to speak of the things that they do in secret.
verses.textEnNkjv: For it is shameful even to speak of those things which are done by them in secret.
verses.textEnNlt: It is shameful even to talk about the things that ungodly people do in secret.
verses.textEnNasb: for it is disgraceful even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.
verses.textEn: It is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.

verses.textZh: 凡被光揭露的，都是显而易见的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡被光揭露的，都是显而易见的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡事受了责备，就被光显明出来，因为一切能显明的就是光。
verses.textEnNiv: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible—and everything that is illuminated becomes a light.
verses.textEnEsv: But when anything is exposed by the light, it becomes visible,
verses.textEnNkjv: But all things that are exposed are made manifest by the light, for whatever makes manifest is light.
verses.textEnNlt: But their evil intentions will be exposed when the light shines on them,
verses.textEnNasb: But all things become visible when they are exposed by the light, for everything that becomes visible is light.
verses.textEn: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible—and everything that is illuminated becomes a light.

verses.textZh: 因为一切显露出来的就是光，所以有话说： "睡了的人哪，醒过来， 从死人中起来吧！ 基督必要照亮你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为一切显露出来的就是光，所以有话说： "睡了的人哪，醒过来， 从死人中起来吧！ 基督必要照亮你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以主说： 你这睡着的人当醒过来， 从死里复活！ 基督就要光照你了。
verses.textEnNiv: This is why it is said: "Wake up, sleeper, rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you."
verses.textEnEsv: for anything that becomes visible is light. Therefore it says, "Awake, O sleeper, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore He says: "Awake, you who sleep, Arise from the dead, And Christ will give you light."
verses.textEnNlt: for the light makes everything visible. This is why it is said, "Awake, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will give you light."
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason it says, "Awake, sleeper, And arise from the dead, And Christ will shine on you."
verses.textEn: This is why it is said: "Wake up, sleeper, rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you."

verses.textZh: 所以，你们行事为人要谨慎，不要像愚昧人，却要像聪明人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，你们行事为人要谨慎，不要像愚昧人，却要像聪明人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要谨慎行事，不要像愚昧人，当像智慧人。
verses.textEnNiv: Be very careful, then, how you live—not as unwise but as wise,
verses.textEnEsv: Look carefully then how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,
verses.textEnNkjv: See then that you walk circumspectly, not as fools but as wise,
verses.textEnNlt: So be careful how you live. Don’t live like fools, but like those who are wise.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, be careful how you walk, not as unwise people but as wise,
verses.textEn: Be very careful, then, how you live—not as unwise but as wise,

verses.textZh: 要把握时机，因为这时代邪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要把握时机，因为这时代邪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 要爱惜光阴，因为现今的世代邪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: making the most of every opportunity, because the days are evil.
verses.textEnEsv: making the best use of the time, because the days are evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
verses.textEnNlt: Make the most of every opportunity in these evil days.
verses.textEnNasb: making the most of your time, because the days are evil.
verses.textEn: making the most of every opportunity, because the days are evil.

verses.textZh: 因此，不要作糊涂人，要明白甚么是主的旨意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，不要作糊涂人，要明白甚么是主的旨意。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要作糊涂人，要明白主的旨意如何。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore do not be unwise, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t act thoughtlessly, but understand what the Lord wants you to do.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
verses.textEn: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.

verses.textZh: 不要醉酒，醉酒能使人放荡乱性，却要让圣灵充满。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要醉酒，醉酒能使人放荡乱性，却要让圣灵充满。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要醉酒，酒能使人放荡；乃要被圣灵充满。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to debauchery. Instead, be filled with the Spirit,
verses.textEnEsv: And do not get drunk with wine, for that is debauchery, but be filled with the Spirit,
verses.textEnNkjv: And do not be drunk with wine, in which is dissipation; but be filled with the Spirit,
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t be drunk with wine, because that will ruin your life. Instead, be filled with the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNasb: And do not get drunk with wine, in which there is debauchery, but be filled with the Spirit,
verses.textEn: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to debauchery. Instead, be filled with the Spirit,

verses.textZh: 应当用诗章、圣诗、灵歌，彼此呼应，口唱心和地赞美主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 应当用诗章、圣诗、灵歌，彼此呼应，口唱心和地赞美主。
verses.textZhCuv: 当用诗章、颂词、灵歌彼此对说，口唱心和地赞美主。
verses.textEnNiv: speaking to one another with psalms, hymns, and songs from the Spirit. Sing and make music from your heart to the Lord,
verses.textEnEsv: addressing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody to the Lord with your heart,
verses.textEnNkjv: speaking to one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: singing psalms and hymns and spiritual songs among yourselves, and making music to the Lord in your hearts.
verses.textEnNasb: speaking to one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody with your hearts to the Lord;
verses.textEn: speaking to one another with psalms, hymns, and songs from the Spirit. Sing and make music from your heart to the Lord,

verses.textZh: 凡事要奉我们主耶稣基督的名，常常感谢父神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡事要奉我们主耶稣基督的名，常常感谢父神，
verses.textZhCuv: 凡事要奉我们主耶稣基督的名常常感谢父神。
verses.textEnNiv: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: giving thanks always and for everything to God the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: giving thanks always for all things to God the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: And give thanks for everything to God the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: always giving thanks for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to our God and Father;
verses.textEn: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 还要存敬畏基督的心，彼此顺服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还要存敬畏基督的心，彼此顺服。
verses.textZhCuv: 又当存敬畏基督的心，彼此顺服。
verses.textEnNiv: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: submitting to one another out of reverence for Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: submitting to one another in the fear of God.
verses.textEnNlt: And further, submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: and subject yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.
verses.textEn: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.

verses.textZh: 你们作妻子的，要顺服自己的丈夫，好象顺服主一样，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作妻子的，要顺服自己的丈夫，好象顺服主一样，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作妻子的，当顺服自己的丈夫，如同顺服主。
verses.textEnNiv: Wives, submit yourselves to your own husbands as you do to the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Wives, submit to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wives, submit to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: For wives, this means submit to your husbands as to the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Wives, subject yourselves to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
verses.textEn: Wives, submit yourselves to your own husbands as you do to the Lord.

verses.textZh: 因为丈夫是妻子的头，好象基督是教会的头；基督又是教会全体的救主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为丈夫是妻子的头，好象基督是教会的头；基督又是教会全体的救主。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为丈夫是妻子的头，如同基督是教会的头；他又是教会全体的救主。
verses.textEnNiv: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, his body, of which he is the Savior.
verses.textEnEsv: For the husband is the head of the wife even as Christ is the head of the church, his body, and is himself its Savior.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the husband is head of the wife, as also Christ is head of the church; and He is the Savior of the body.
verses.textEnNlt: For a husband is the head of his wife as Christ is the head of the church. He is the Savior of his body, the church.
verses.textEnNasb: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the church, He Himself being the Savior of the body.
verses.textEn: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, his body, of which he is the Savior.

verses.textZh: 教会怎样顺服基督，妻子也要照样凡事顺服丈夫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 教会怎样顺服基督，妻子也要照样凡事顺服丈夫。
verses.textZhCuv: 教会怎样顺服基督，妻子也要怎样凡事顺服丈夫。
verses.textEnNiv: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
verses.textEnEsv: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit in everything to their husbands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, just as the church is subject to Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in everything.
verses.textEnNlt: As the church submits to Christ, so you wives should submit to your husbands in everything.
verses.textEnNasb: But as the church is subject to Christ, so also the wives ought to be to their husbands in everything.
verses.textEn: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.

verses.textZh: 你们作丈夫的，要爱妻子，好象基督爱教会，为教会舍己，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作丈夫的，要爱妻子，好象基督爱教会，为教会舍己，
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作丈夫的，要爱你们的妻子，正如基督爱教会，为教会舍己。
verses.textEnNiv: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her
verses.textEnEsv: Husbands, love your wives, as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her,
verses.textEnNkjv: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ also loved the church and gave Himself for her,
verses.textEnNlt: For husbands, this means love your wives, just as Christ loved the church. He gave up his life for her
verses.textEnNasb: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ also loved the church and gave Himself up for her,
verses.textEn: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her

verses.textZh: 为的是要用水借着道把教会洗净，成为圣洁，
verses.textZhCnvs: 为的是要用水借着道把教会洗净，成为圣洁，
verses.textZhCuv: 要用水藉着道把教会洗净，成为圣洁，
verses.textEnNiv: to make her holy, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,
verses.textEnEsv: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,
verses.textEnNkjv: that He might sanctify and cleanse her with the washing of water by the word,
verses.textEnNlt: to make her holy and clean, washed by the cleansing of God’s word.
verses.textEnNasb: so that He might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,
verses.textEn: to make her holy, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,

verses.textZh: 可以作荣耀的教会归给自己，甚么污点皱纹等也没有，而是圣洁没有瑕疵的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可以作荣耀的教会归给自己，甚么污点皱纹等也没有，而是圣洁没有瑕疵的。
verses.textZhCuv: 可以献给自己，作个荣耀的教会，毫无玷污、皱纹等类的病，乃是圣洁没有瑕疵的。
verses.textEnNiv: and to present her to himself as a radiant church, without stain or wrinkle or any other blemish, but holy and blameless.
verses.textEnEsv: so that he might present the church to himself in splendor, without spot or wrinkle or any such thing, that she might be holy and without blemish.
verses.textEnNkjv: that He might present her to Himself a glorious church, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without blemish.
verses.textEnNlt: He did this to present her to himself as a glorious church without a spot or wrinkle or any other blemish. Instead, she will be holy and without fault.
verses.textEnNasb: that He might present to Himself the church in all her glory, having no spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that she would be holy and blameless.
verses.textEn: and to present her to himself as a radiant church, without stain or wrinkle or any other blemish, but holy and blameless.

verses.textZh: 丈夫也应当这样爱妻子，好象爱自己的身体一样。爱妻子的，就是爱自己了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 丈夫也应当这样爱妻子，好象爱自己的身体一样。爱妻子的，就是爱自己了。
verses.textZhCuv: 丈夫也当照样爱妻子，如同爱自己的身子；爱妻子便是爱自己了。
verses.textEnNiv: In this same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
verses.textEnEsv: In the same way husbands should love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: So husbands ought to love their own wives as their own bodies; he who loves his wife loves himself.
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as they love their own bodies. For a man who loves his wife actually shows love for himself.
verses.textEnNasb: So husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself;
verses.textEn: In this same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.

verses.textZh: 从来没有人恨恶自己的身体，总是保养顾惜，好象基督对教会一样，
verses.textZhCnvs: 从来没有人恨恶自己的身体，总是保养顾惜，好象基督对教会一样，
verses.textZhCuv: 从来没有人恨恶自己的身子，总是保养顾惜，正像基督待教会一样，
verses.textEnNiv: After all, no one ever hated their own body, but they feed and care for their body, just as Christ does the church—
verses.textEnEsv: For no one ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ does the church,
verses.textEnNkjv: For no one ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, just as the Lord does the church.
verses.textEnNlt: No one hates his own body but feeds and cares for it, just as Christ cares for the church.
verses.textEnNasb: for no one ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ also does the church,
verses.textEn: After all, no one ever hated their own body, but they feed and care for their body, just as Christ does the church—

verses.textZh: 因为我们是他身上的肢体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们是他身上的肢体。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我们是他身上的肢体 。
verses.textEnNiv: for we are members of his body.
verses.textEnEsv: because we are members of his body.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we are members of His body, of His flesh and of His bones.
verses.textEnNlt: And we are members of his body.
verses.textEnNasb: because we are parts of His body.
verses.textEn: for we are members of his body.

verses.textZh: 为了这缘故，人要离开父母，与妻子结合，二人成为一体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了这缘故，人要离开父母，与妻子结合，二人成为一体。
verses.textZhCuv: 为这个缘故，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。
verses.textEnNiv: "For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh."
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore a man shall leave his father and mother and hold fast to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh."
verses.textEnNkjv: "For this reason a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh."
verses.textEnNlt: As the Scriptures say, "A man leaves his father and mother and is joined to his wife, and the two are united into one."
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason a man shall leave his father and his mother and be joined to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh.
verses.textEn: "For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh."

verses.textZh: 这是极大的奥秘，但我是指着基督和教会说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是极大的奥秘，但我是指着基督和教会说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是极大的奥秘，但我是指着基督和教会说的。
verses.textEnNiv: This is a profound mystery—but I am talking about Christ and the church.
verses.textEnEsv: This mystery is profound, and I am saying that it refers to Christ and the church.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is a great mystery, but I speak concerning Christ and the church.
verses.textEnNlt: This is a great mystery, but it is an illustration of the way Christ and the church are one.
verses.textEnNasb: This mystery is great; but I am speaking with reference to Christ and the church.
verses.textEn: This is a profound mystery—but I am talking about Christ and the church.

verses.textZh: 无论怎样，你们各人都要爱自己的妻子，好象爱自己一样。妻子也应当敬重丈夫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论怎样，你们各人都要爱自己的妻子，好象爱自己一样。妻子也应当敬重丈夫。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，你们各人都当爱妻子，如同爱自己一样。妻子也当敬重她的丈夫。
verses.textEnNiv: However, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
verses.textEnEsv: However, let each one of you love his wife as himself, and let the wife see that she respects her husband.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless let each one of you in particular so love his own wife as himself, and let the wife see that she respects her husband.
verses.textEnNlt: So again I say, each man must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, as for you individually, each husband is to love his own wife the same as himself, and the wife must see to it that she respects her husband.
verses.textEn: However, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.

verses.textZh: 你们作儿女的，要在主里听从父母，因为这是理所当然的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作儿女的，要在主里听从父母，因为这是理所当然的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作儿女的，要在主里听从父母，这是理所当然的。
verses.textEnNiv: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
verses.textEnEsv: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
verses.textEnNkjv: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
verses.textEnNlt: Children, obey your parents because you belong to the Lord, for this is the right thing to do.
verses.textEnNasb: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
verses.textEn: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

verses.textZh: 你们作父亲的，不要激怒儿女，却要照着主的教训和劝戒，养育他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作父亲的，不要激怒儿女，却要照着主的教训和劝戒，养育他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作父亲的，不要惹儿女的气，只要照着主的教训和警戒养育他们。
verses.textEnNiv: "Honor your father and mother"—which is the first commandment with a promise—
verses.textEnEsv: "Honor your father and mother" (this is the first commandment with a promise),
verses.textEnNkjv: "Honor your father and mother," which is the first commandment with promise:
verses.textEnNlt: "Honor your father and mother." This is the first commandment with a promise:
verses.textEnNasb: Honor your father and mother (which is the first commandment with a promise),
verses.textEn: "Honor your father and mother"—which is the first commandment with a promise—

verses.textZh: 你们作仆人的，要存着敬畏、战兢和真诚的心，听从世上的主人，好象听从基督一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作仆人的，要存着敬畏、战兢和真诚的心，听从世上的主人，好象听从基督一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作仆人的，要惧怕战兢，用诚实的心听从你们肉身的主人，好像听从基督一般。
verses.textEnNiv: "so that it may go well with you and that you may enjoy long life on the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: "that it may go well with you and that you may live long in the land."
verses.textEnNkjv: "that it may be well with you and you may live long on the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: If you honor your father and mother, "things will go well for you, and you will have a long life on the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: so that it may turn out well for you, and that you may live long on the earth.
verses.textEn: "so that it may go well with you and that you may enjoy long life on the earth."

verses.textZh: 作事不要只作给人看，像那些讨人欢心的一样，却要像基督的仆人，从心里遵行神的旨意，
verses.textZhCnvs: 作事不要只作给人看，像那些讨人欢心的一样，却要像基督的仆人，从心里遵行神的旨意，
verses.textZhCuv: 不要只在眼前事奉，像是讨人喜欢的，要像基督的仆人，从心里遵行神的旨意。
verses.textEnNiv: Fathers, do not exasperate your children; instead, bring them up in the training and instruction of the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger, but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you, fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath, but bring them up in the training and admonition of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger by the way you treat them. Rather, bring them up with the discipline and instruction that comes from the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger, but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Fathers, do not exasperate your children; instead, bring them up in the training and instruction of the Lord.

verses.textZh: 甘心服务，像是服事主，不是服事人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 甘心服务，像是服事主，不是服事人。
verses.textZhCuv: 甘心事奉，好像服事主，不像服事人。
verses.textEnNiv: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear, and with sincerity of heart, just as you would obey Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: Bondservants, obey your earthly masters with fear and trembling, with a sincere heart, as you would Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: Bondservants, be obedient to those who are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in sincerity of heart, as to Christ;
verses.textEnNlt: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with deep respect and fear. Serve them sincerely as you would serve Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: Slaves, be obedient to those who are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in the sincerity of your heart, as to Christ;
verses.textEn: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear, and with sincerity of heart, just as you would obey Christ.

verses.textZh: 你们知道，无论是奴仆或自由的人，如果作了甚么善事，都必从主那里得到赏赐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们知道，无论是奴仆或自由的人，如果作了甚么善事，都必从主那里得到赏赐。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为晓得各人所行的善事，不论是为奴的，是自主的，都必按所行的得主的赏赐。
verses.textEnNiv: Obey them not only to win their favor when their eye is on you, but as slaves of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.
verses.textEnEsv: not by the way of eye-service, as people-pleasers, but as bondservants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,
verses.textEnNkjv: not with eyeservice, as men-pleasers, but as bondservants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,
verses.textEnNlt: Try to please them all the time, not just when they are watching you. As slaves of Christ, do the will of God with all your heart.
verses.textEnNasb: not by way of eye-service, as people-pleasers, but as slaves of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart.
verses.textEn: Obey them not only to win their favor when their eye is on you, but as slaves of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.

verses.textZh: 你们作主人的，也要照样对待奴仆，不要威吓他们；你们知道，他们和你们在天上同有一位主，他并不偏待人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作主人的，也要照样对待奴仆，不要威吓他们；你们知道，他们和你们在天上同有一位主，他并不偏待人。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们作主人的，待仆人也是一理，不要威吓他们。因为知道，他们和你们同有一位主在天上；他并不偏待人。
verses.textEnNiv: Serve wholeheartedly, as if you were serving the Lord, not people,
verses.textEnEsv: rendering service with a good will as to the Lord and not to man,
verses.textEnNkjv: with goodwill doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men,
verses.textEnNlt: Work with enthusiasm, as though you were working for the Lord rather than for people.
verses.textEnNasb: With goodwill render service, as to the Lord, and not to people,
verses.textEn: Serve wholeheartedly, as if you were serving the Lord, not people,

verses.textZh: 最后，你们要靠主的大能大力，在他里面刚强。
verses.textZhCnvs: 最后，你们要靠主的大能大力，在他里面刚强。
verses.textZhCuv: 我还有末了的话：你们要靠着主，倚赖他的大能大力作刚强的人。
verses.textEnNiv: because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good they do, whether they are slave or free.
verses.textEnEsv: knowing that whatever good anyone does, this he will receive back from the Lord, whether he is a bondservant or is free.
verses.textEnNkjv: knowing that whatever good anyone does, he will receive the same from the Lord, whether heis a slave or free.
verses.textEnNlt: Remember that the Lord will reward each one of us for the good we do, whether we are slaves or free.
verses.textEnNasb: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive this back from the Lord, whether slave or free.
verses.textEn: because you know that the Lord will reward each one for whatever good they do, whether they are slave or free.

verses.textZh: 要穿戴神所赐的全副军装，使你们能抵挡魔鬼的诡计。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要穿戴神所赐的全副军装，使你们能抵挡魔鬼的诡计。
verses.textZhCuv: 要穿戴神所赐的全副军装，就能抵挡魔鬼的诡计。
verses.textEnNiv: And masters, treat your slaves in the same way. Do not threaten them, since you know that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with him.
verses.textEnEsv: Masters, do the same to them, and stop your threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and that there is no partiality with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you, masters, do the same things to them, giving up threatening, knowing that your own Master also is in heaven, and there is no partiality with Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Masters, treat your slaves in the same way. Don’t threaten them; remember, you both have the same Master in heaven, and he has no favorites.
verses.textEnNasb: And masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with Him.
verses.textEn: And masters, treat your slaves in the same way. Do not threaten them, since you know that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no favoritism with him.

verses.textZh: 因为我们的争战，对抗的不是有血有肉的人，而是执政的、掌权的、管辖这黑暗世界的和天上的邪灵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们的争战，对抗的不是有血有肉的人，而是执政的、掌权的、管辖这黑暗世界的和天上的邪灵。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我们并不是与属血气的争战 ，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的，以及天空属灵气的恶魔争战。
verses.textEnNiv: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.
verses.textEnEsv: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.
verses.textEnNkjv: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord and in the power of His might.
verses.textEnNlt: A final word: Be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.
verses.textEnNasb: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of His might.
verses.textEn: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.

verses.textZh: 所以要穿起神所赐的全副军装，使你们在这邪恶的时代里可以抵挡得住，并且在作完了一切之后，还能站立得稳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以要穿起神所赐的全副军装，使你们在这邪恶的时代里可以抵挡得住，并且在作完了一切之后，还能站立得稳。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，要拿起神所赐的全副军装，好在磨难的日子抵挡仇敌，并且成就了一切，还能站立得住。
verses.textEnNiv: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil’s schemes.
verses.textEnEsv: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the schemes of the devil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
verses.textEnNlt: Put on all of God’s armor so that you will be able to stand firm against all strategies of the devil.
verses.textEnNasb: Put on the full armor of God, so that you will be able to stand firm against the schemes of the devil.
verses.textEn: Put on the full armor of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil’s schemes.

verses.textZh: 因此，你们要站稳，用真理当带子束腰，披上公义的胸甲，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你们要站稳，用真理当带子束腰，披上公义的胸甲，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以要站稳了，用真理当作带子束腰，用公义当作护心镜遮胸，
verses.textEnNiv: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
verses.textEnEsv: For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the cosmic powers over this present darkness, against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly places.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this age, against spiritual hosts of wickedness in the heavenly places.
verses.textEnNlt: For we are not fighting against flesh-and-blood enemies, but against evil rulers and authorities of the unseen world, against mighty powers in this dark world, and against evil spirits in the heavenly places.
verses.textEnNasb: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the powers, against the world forces of this darkness, against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.
verses.textEn: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.

verses.textZh: 把和平的福音预备好了，当作鞋子，穿在脚上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 把和平的福音预备好了，当作鞋子，穿在脚上，
verses.textZhCuv: 又用平安的福音当作预备走路的鞋穿在脚上。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore put on the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you may be able to stand your ground, and after you have done everything, to stand.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore take up the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand firm.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore take up the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, put on every piece of God’s armor so you will be able to resist the enemy in the time of evil. Then after the battle you will still be standing firm.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, take up the full armor of God, so that you will be able to resist on the evil day, and having done everything, to stand firm.
verses.textEn: Therefore put on the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you may be able to stand your ground, and after you have done everything, to stand.

verses.textZh: 拿起信心的盾牌，用来扑灭那恶者所有的火箭；
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿起信心的盾牌，用来扑灭那恶者所有的火箭；
verses.textZhCuv: 此外，又拿着信德当作盾牌，可以灭尽那恶者一切的火箭；
verses.textEnNiv: Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness in place,
verses.textEnEsv: Stand therefore, having fastened on the belt of truth, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
verses.textEnNkjv: Stand therefore, having girded your waist with truth, having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
verses.textEnNlt: Stand your ground, putting on the belt of truth and the body armor of God’s righteousness.
verses.textEnNasb: Stand firm therefore, having belted your waist with truth, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
verses.textEn: Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness in place,

verses.textZh: 并且要戴上救恩的头盔，拿起圣灵的宝剑，就是神的道，
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且要戴上救恩的头盔，拿起圣灵的宝剑，就是神的道，
verses.textZhCuv: 并戴上救恩的头盔，拿着圣灵的宝剑，就是神的道；
verses.textEnNiv: and with your feet fitted with the readiness that comes from the gospel of peace.
verses.textEnEsv: and, as shoes for your feet, having put on the readiness given by the gospel of peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: and having shod your feet with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
verses.textEnNlt: For shoes, put on the peace that comes from the Good News so that you will be fully prepared.
verses.textEnNasb: and having strapped on your feet the preparation of the gospel of peace;
verses.textEn: and with your feet fitted with the readiness that comes from the gospel of peace.

verses.textZh: 借着各样的祷告和祈求，随时在圣灵里祈祷，并且要在这事上恒久警醒，为众圣徒祈求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 借着各样的祷告和祈求，随时在圣灵里祈祷，并且要在这事上恒久警醒，为众圣徒祈求。
verses.textZhCuv: 靠着圣灵，随时多方祷告祈求；并要在此警醒不倦，为众圣徒祈求，
verses.textEnNiv: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
verses.textEnEsv: In all circumstances take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming darts of the evil one;
verses.textEnNkjv: above all, taking the shield of faith with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked one.
verses.textEnNlt: In addition to all of these, hold up the shield of faith to stop the fiery arrows of the devil.
verses.textEnNasb: in addition to all, taking up the shield of faith with which you will be able to extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
verses.textEn: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

verses.textZh: 也要为我祈求，使我传讲的时候，得着当说的话，可以坦然无惧地讲明福音的奥秘，
verses.textZhCnvs: 也要为我祈求，使我传讲的时候，得着当说的话，可以坦然无惧地讲明福音的奥秘，
verses.textZhCuv: 也为我祈求，使我得着口才，能以放胆开口讲明福音的奥秘，
verses.textEnNiv: Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
verses.textEnEsv: and take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;
verses.textEnNlt: Put on salvation as your helmet, and take the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
verses.textEnNasb: And take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
verses.textEn: Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

verses.textZh: ，也使我按着应当说的，放胆宣讲这福音的奥秘。
verses.textZhCnvs: ，也使我按着应当说的，放胆宣讲这福音的奥秘。
verses.textZhCuv: （我为这福音的奥秘作了带锁链的使者，）并使我照着当尽的本分放胆讲论。
verses.textEnNiv: And pray in the Spirit on all occasions with all kinds of prayers and requests. With this in mind, be alert and always keep on praying for all the Lord’s people.
verses.textEnEsv: praying at all times in the Spirit, with all prayer and supplication. To that end, keep alert with all perseverance, making supplication for all the saints,
verses.textEnNkjv: praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, being watchful to this end with all perseverance and supplication for all the saints—
verses.textEnNlt: Pray in the Spirit at all times and on every occasion. Stay alert and be persistent in your prayers for all believers everywhere.
verses.textEnNasb: With every prayer and request, pray at all times in the Spirit, and with this in view, be alert with all perseverance and every request for all the saints,
verses.textEn: And pray in the Spirit on all occasions with all kinds of prayers and requests. With this in mind, be alert and always keep on praying for all the Lord’s people.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的推基古弟兄是主里忠心的仆人，他会把我的一切都告诉你们，使你们可以知道我的景况。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的推基古弟兄是主里忠心的仆人，他会把我的一切都告诉你们，使你们可以知道我的景况。
verses.textZhCuv: 今有所亲爱、忠心事奉主的兄弟推基古，他要把我的事情，并我的景况如何全告诉你们，叫你们知道。
verses.textEnNiv: Pray also for me, that whenever I speak, words may be given me so that I will fearlessly make known the mystery of the gospel,
verses.textEnEsv: and also for me, that words may be given to me in opening my mouth boldly to proclaim the mystery of the gospel,
verses.textEnNkjv: and for me, that utterance may be given to me, that I may open my mouth boldly to make known the mystery of the gospel,
verses.textEnNlt: And pray for me, too. Ask God to give me the right words so I can boldly explain God’s mysterious plan that the Good News is for Jews and Gentiles alike.
verses.textEnNasb: and pray in my behalf, that speech may be given to me in the opening of my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the gospel,
verses.textEn: Pray also for me, that whenever I speak, words may be given me so that I will fearlessly make known the mystery of the gospel,

verses.textZh: 为了这缘故，我就差他到你们那里去，好让你们明白我们的近况，并且叫他安慰你们的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了这缘故，我就差他到你们那里去，好让你们明白我们的近况，并且叫他安慰你们的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 我特意打发他到你们那里去，好叫你们知道我们的光景，又叫他安慰你们的心。
verses.textEnNiv: for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may declare it fearlessly, as I should.
verses.textEnEsv: for which I am an ambassador in chains, that I may declare it boldly, as I ought to speak.
verses.textEnNkjv: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
verses.textEnNlt: I am in chains now, still preaching this message as God’s ambassador. So pray that I will keep on speaking boldly for him, as I should.
verses.textEnNasb: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in proclaiming it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
verses.textEn: for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may declare it fearlessly, as I should.

verses.textZh: 愿平安、慈爱、信心，从父神和主耶稣基督临到众弟兄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿平安、慈爱、信心，从父神和主耶稣基督临到众弟兄。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿平安、仁爱、信心从父神和主耶稣基督归与弟兄们！
verses.textEnNiv: Tychicus, the dear brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know how I am and what I am doing.
verses.textEnEsv: So that you also may know how I am and what I am doing, Tychicus the beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord will tell you everything.
verses.textEnNkjv: But that you also may know my affairs and how I am doing, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, will make all things known to you;
verses.textEnNlt: To bring you up to date, Tychicus will give you a full report about what I am doing and how I am getting along. He is a beloved brother and faithful helper in the Lord’s work.
verses.textEnNasb: Now, so that you also may know about my circumstances as to what I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make everything known to you.
verses.textEn: Tychicus, the dear brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know how I am and what I am doing.

verses.textZh: 愿一切以不朽的爱爱我们主耶稣基督的人，都蒙恩惠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿一切以不朽的爱爱我们主耶稣基督的人，都蒙恩惠。
verses.textZhCuv: 并愿所有诚心爱我们主耶稣基督的人都蒙恩惠！
verses.textEnNiv: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that you may know how we are, and that he may encourage you.
verses.textEnEsv: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know how we are, and that he may encourage your hearts.
verses.textEnNkjv: whom I have sent to you for this very purpose, that you may know our affairs, and that he may comfort your hearts.
verses.textEnNlt: I have sent him to you for this very purpose—to let you know how we are doing and to encourage you.
verses.textEnNasb: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, so that you may know about us, and that he may comfort your hearts.
verses.textEn: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that you may know how we are, and that he may encourage you.

verses.textEnNiv: Peace to the brothers and sisters, and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Peace to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Peace be with you, dear brothers and sisters, and may God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you love with faithfulness.
verses.textEnNasb: Peace be to the brothers and sisters, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: Peace to the brothers and sisters, and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textEnNiv: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
verses.textEnEsv: Grace be with all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with love incorruptible.
verses.textEnNkjv: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: May God’s grace be eternally upon all who love our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love.
verses.textEn: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
